name: Tapovan
tagline: Yoga and cafe hub for travellers
description: The main travellers' hub above Laxman Jhula, densely packed with yoga schools, cafes, guesthouses and shops. With Ganges views and a laid-back international crowd, Tapovan is the default base for nomads and yoga students staying in Rishikesh.
bestFor: Nomads and yoga students wanting cafes, classes and an international scene

name: Laxman Jhula
tagline: Riverside area by the famous bridge
description: A riverside quarter around the iconic suspension footbridge, lined with temples, cafes, ashrams and shops. Central to the traveller scene and full of Ganges-side viewpoints, it stays lively though the original bridge has been closed for safety.
bestFor: Travellers wanting riverside cafes, temples and easy access to the traveller scene

name: Ram Jhula
tagline: Ashram and temple heart of Rishikesh
description: A quieter riverside area around the Ram Jhula bridge, anchored by large ashrams like Parmarth Niketan and the evening Ganga aarti. More spiritual and calm than Tapovan, it suits those focused on yoga, meditation and ashram life.
bestFor: Visitors focused on ashrams, meditation and a quieter spiritual atmosphere

name: High Bank
description: A small elevated enclave above Tapovan reached by a steep climb, with a cluster of guesthouses, cafes and forest views. Quieter and cooler than the riverside, High Bank draws longer-stay travellers seeking calm and greenery near the action.
bestFor: Long-stay nomads wanting calm hilltop views and greenery near Tapovan
